trust_decision.summary: Whether a YAML document (SCA policy) may expand anchors/aliases into an unbounded number of JSON nodes is decided in the recursive YAML-to-cJSON converter, which at the pinned commit already caps nodes at YAML2JSON_MAX_NODES.

landing_point.why: Summary says SCA YAML alias expansion; wm_sca.c calls yaml2json(), whose recursive yaml2json_node re-walks aliased nodes - the only place expansion happens.

fix_sites.entry_point: SCA module policy load (wm_sca.c:381, policies from ossec.conf <sca><policies>)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site or O8 route exists; the only other libyaml user (remoted shared_download.c) is event-based and never expands aliases.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate SCA policies using anchors/aliases, and large bundled policies (~18000 nodes per the comment), must still convert; disabling aliases outright or a tight cap breaks them.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An event-API YAML reader for shared-download config could gain alias resolution (YAML_ALIAS_EVENT re-reading anchored values) without a bound.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer adding anchor support to the hand-written event parser could plausibly copy anchored subtrees without counting.

O9_family: CWE-776 XML/YAML entity (alias) expansion - billion-laughs memory exhaustion

O10_build.toolchain: make / CMake, gcc, bundled libyaml and cJSON under src/external, cmocka for unit tests
O10_build.project_tests: src/unit_tests/shared/test_yaml2json_op.c (registered at src/unit_tests/shared/CMakeLists.txt:308) - already includes test_yaml2json_alias_expansion_rejected

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a node/recursion counter in yaml2json_node (which is exactly what is already present).

out_of_scope_notes: Python framework/API YAML loading uses yaml.safe_load (e.g. api/api/configuration.py:320), which is a separate library and not part of this SCA advisory.
unverified: The supplied fix diff (fix.diff:1-2) is an empty merge commit 'bump-4.14.8'; the real fix appears to have landed before the pinned commit, since the YAML2JSON_MAX_NODES guard (src/shared/yaml2json.c:20,90-93) and its alias-expansion regression test (src/unit_tests/shared/test_yaml2json_op.c:78-110) are present at the pin. The vulnerable state is NOT in the pinned tree; a task would need re-pinning to the commit before the guard was added (could not run git log to locate it).
regression_tests_in_pinned_commit flagged on the basis that the advisory's regression test is in the pinned tree; strictly, the empty diff adds no test files to compare.
Whether wm_sca also parses remotely pushed (centralized-config) policies via another path was not traced beyond the single yaml_parse_file/yaml2json call site.
